name: Drogath Ash-Eye
source_profile: ● Drogath Ash-Eye (N) is an elderly clan shaman who remembers the independent communities that existed before Urzak's ascendancy. He fears that endless warfare will destroy the mountain clans and quietly assists those who wish to leave the Host.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 50 (source excerpt; may be partial)
